Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz
Installation documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/
Retrieved 2026-11-05 over HTTPS. License: Apache-2.0 (included in tarball).
SHA-256: `8dc73fc3b00203e72d176e85b50938627c7b086e607c682e8d3c22c02bb99fe8`

This replaces the stale npm 0.18.5 release and preserves XLS, XLSX, and XLSM import. npm's lockfile also records SHA-512 integrity. No patched third-party fork is used.
